text: おともだちの　べっそうに　きて　いますの

structure.jp: おともだちの　べっそうに

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after 'come' says the person came and is still here. きて います = 'I have come and am here'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is a ladylike short form of のです, which adds a soft feeling of explaining. きて いますの = 'I'm here on a visit, you see'.
